purpose: Compare desktop PyTorch FP32 model-only latency for the original and representative recovered pruning candidates
timing_note: Two ordered passes: original, weight192, ablation192, ablation184, ablation176, weight160 and reverse. These are not randomized and do not isolate runtime thermal effects.

limits: No controlled power or temperature; two runs; desktop GPU only; not end-to-end or Orin.
